name: RAISED_TO_RIGHT_HAND
canonical: the humbled Servant lifted up out of the pit below and exalted high into radiant glory, raised to the place of highest honor at the right hand of power; the divine presence shown ONLY as a high warm radiance above — NO face, NO body, NO throne-figure, NO human form of God depicted
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
